calculation.expression: ((ret_20 - cross_sectional_median(ret_20)) - (ret_60 - cross_sectional_median(ret_60))) / downside_volatility_40d, then lag 1 day
calculation.description: Ranks cross-asset acceleration in relative 20-day versus 60-day momentum, scaling each asset by trailing 40-day downside return volatility. The one-day lag ensures only completed-day information is used.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in all tested regimes; strongest in 2030-2032 and materially weaker in 2033-2035. Small 15-instrument cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
